name: Chunked Parallel SDF Generation
definition: A parallel processing strategy that divides the world into chunks, computes SDF values for each chunk independently using Rayon, and merges SDF contributions from intersecting shapes using a minimum function.
summary: Chunked Parallel SDF Generation is a multi-threaded strategy that divides a world into independent chunks to compute Signed Distance Functions concurrently, solving sequential bottlenecks by processing spatial regions simultaneously.
